items.title: BlockStrap: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE)
items.summary: BlockStrap is a CVSS 10.0 vulnerability allowing unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution through a template engine injection. Adobe released a fix in APSB26-153, but it requires a manual patch, and new installations remain vulnerable.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (Multiple Vulnerabilities)
items.summary: This security update addresses multiple vulnerabilities rated critical, high, and medium, including CVE-2026-103849, which could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system write, and security feature bypass. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for these issues.

items.title: StyleSmuggler: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE)
items.summary: StyleSmuggler is a zero-day vulnerability with a CVSS score of 10.0 that allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution by injecting malicious code into Magento's template system. Attacks were observed starting September 4th, and Adobe released an emergency hotfix on September 7th.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (CVE-2026-75650)
items.summary: This critical security update resolves a vulnerability (CVE-2026-75650) that could result in arbitrary code execution. Adobe is aware that this CVE is being exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (Multiple Vulnerabilities)
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for these issues.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Account Takeover
items.summary: This critical vulnerability (CVSS 9.1) allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account and escalate privileges without requiring administrator access. Indications of active exploitation in the wild emerged shortly after disclosure.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (Multiple Vulnerabilities)
items.summary: This security update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities, including an unauthenticated incorrect authorization flaw (CVE-2026-71362) that could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for the issues addressed in this update, though third-party reports indicate otherwise for CVE-2026-71362.

items.title: Unauthenticated Unrestricted File Upload
items.summary: PolyShell allows attackers to upload executable files to any Magento or Adobe Commerce store via the REST API without authentication. Sansec has observed attacks on a significant percentage of stores.

items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in the Amasty Order Attributes extension allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.
